title: Lean Founder
outcome: Keep it lean: a compact vision brief and a first learning experiment, with more documents only when you choose to add them.

minimumInputs.help: What is the need or idea, in your own words?
minimumInputs.example: A simple way for freelancers to track unpaid invoices.

minimumInputs.help: What progress do you want to make next?
minimumInputs.example: Ten paying users within three months.

minimumInputs.prompt: Stated constraints without inferring budget or team size
minimumInputs.help: What limits do you have? Kryterea will not guess your budget or team size.
minimumInputs.example: Just me, evenings only, launch before summer.

minimumInputs.prompt: Idea or need in the user's words
minimumInputs.help: Describe the idea or the need the way you would explain it to a friend.
minimumInputs.example: Suppliers keep chasing us by email because they cannot see if their invoice was approved.

minimumInputs.help: What is in and out of scope for this exploration? Rough boundaries are fine.
minimumInputs.example: Invoice status only; payments and contracts are out of scope for now.

minimumInputs.help: Nothing to fill in. Anything not yet known about users, value or metrics is written as a hypothesis to test.
What do you believe is true but have not proven? Write it as a guess you can test.
minimumInputs.example: Suppliers who can see invoice status will stop emailing accounts payable.

minimumInputs.help: How could you test that guess quickly and cheaply? Or describe a test you already ran.
minimumInputs.example: Email ten suppliers a status link for two weeks and count follow-up emails.

minimumInputs.prompt: Distinguish planned work from observed results
minimumInputs.help: Nothing to fill in. Planned steps and real results are kept apart, so nothing is reported as done before it happened.
Who is the main user of what will be built?
minimumInputs.example: Approving managers who receive invoices for sign-off.

minimumInputs.help: What should the user be able to do that they cannot do today?
minimumInputs.example: Approve an invoice from their phone in under a minute.

minimumInputs.help: What is included in this piece of work, and what is not?
minimumInputs.example: Approval and rejection only; editing invoice details is not included.

minimumInputs.prompt: Acceptance expectations proposed where not confirmed
minimumInputs.help: Optional. How you would know a story is done. Kryterea proposes acceptance criteria where you have none, marked as proposed.

minimumInputs.prompt: At least one explicit decision question or actual recorded decision
minimumInputs.help: What decision needs making, or was already made?
minimumInputs.example: Decided to build approval by email first, before a mobile app.

minimumInputs.help: Who made or owns the decision, if you know? Leave blank if not.
minimumInputs.example: Finance director, at the steering meeting.

minimumInputs.help: Nothing to fill in. Open questions are kept as pending, not answered for you.
What result do you want this work to deliver?
minimumInputs.example: Invoices approved within five days and fewer supplier complaints.

minimumInputs.help: Which solution or process is being measured?
What could you measure to see if it is working?
minimumInputs.example: Days from invoice received to approved; number of chase emails.

minimumInputs.help: Nothing to fill in. If you have no targets, Kryterea proposes some for you to confirm.
What is the work or goal these risks relate to?
minimumInputs.example: Roll out the approval workflow to all departments by June.

minimumInputs.help: What could go wrong or is uncertain, and why do you think so?
minimumInputs.example: The finance system interface is undocumented; IT has warned us.

minimumInputs.help: Nothing to fill in. Likelihood and impact scales are proposed if you have none.
